main_text.l: & quo modo ascensiones ac descensiones ex his eliciendae sint,
uel cuiusq; arcus zodiaci, dicitur portio æquatoris,
quæ cum eo signo uel arcu cooritur. Ptolemæo ἀναφορὰ.
DESCENSIO uel occasus signi uel alicu-
ius arcus zodiaci dicitur portio æquatoris, quæ
cum eo signo uel arcu zodiaci una demergitur. Et
distinguuntur arcus zodiaci in continuos & Di-
scretos. Continui uocantur, qui à puncto
mensurantur. Discreti uero qui à quouis alio Ecliptice puncto incho-
antur, quàm signo æquinoctij uerni seu consectione
Quod uero ortus & occasus partium significeri non

page.notes: Passage in italic type throughout; heading-like lines ASCENSIO and DESCENSIO set in spaced capitals. Greek word ἀναφορὰ printed after Ptolemæo; the rendering of the Greek may be imperfect. Last line of the page ends with "non" (printed as a catchword-like continuation, kept in text).
